notes.title: 🚀 Space Scum Playtest Update
notes.content: [h1][b]🛰️ Incoming Transmission, Mercenaries![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The galaxy just got a little safer and a little smarter. Version [b]0.6.5.16[/b] is live with plenty of fixes, smarter AI, and quality of life improvements that should make your battles more fair and your missions more reliable.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes & Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when a crew member had more than 10 abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when opening a Robot Systems shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game not fully closing on Steam[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes & QoL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed characters appearing to have more Focus than they actually do due to rounding up[/p][/*][*][p]Status effects are no longer applied to downed characters in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Automated Sentries are no longer included in checks to see if a team has been wiped out in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Player crew members who are downed in battle now have a chance to survive at the end (provided they still have a head attached)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missions sometimes being created for non-existent enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missions not spawning or vanishing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hair turning white on characters that were downed in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed footprints on the world map not saving or loading correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Game now auto pauses on load, when leaving a settlement or when closing the crew menu (settings menu toggles for these will come in a later update)[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Combat & Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some area of effect attacks not correctly displaying their targeted tiles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the difficulty display of some enemy packs on the world map not matching their actual difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies using abilities when they did not have enough Focus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some higher tier weapons not having the correct damage[/p][/*][*][p]Force Field and Armour Penetration now scales with the targets remaining Force Field or Armour[/p][/*][*][p]Durability of equipment has changed, lower quality items now have less and higher quality items now have more[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Shield item tooltip displaying unnecessary data[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]AI is now more aggressive when they or their team mates are targeted[/p][/*][*][p]AI should now know the requirements to use certain abilities[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛒 [b]Economy & Missions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Mission reward money has been reworked, generally courier missions reward less[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could make a courier missions secondary objective impossible[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖊️ [b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed typos[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game rolling a D101 rather than a D100[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed line of sight issues with outdoor battles with elevations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]📡 [b]That's All For Now[/b][/h2][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][i]Until next time, stay scrappy and watch your six![/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p]Another Forklift-published game [b]Roman Triumph[/b] has just launched in 1.0! 🏛️[/p][p]Build your city, defend it from invaders, please the gods, and see how long you can survive 👇🏻[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864880/Roman_Triumph_Survival_City_Builder/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2601980/view/500584797655010475"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a crash when a crew member had more than 10 abilities
Fixed a crash that could occur when opening a Robot Systems shop
Fixed game not fully closing on Steam
Fixed characters appearing to have more Focus than they actually do due to rounding up
Status effects are no longer applied to downed characters in a tactical battle
Automated Sentries are no longer included in checks to see if a team has been wiped out in a tactical battle
Player crew members who are downed in battle now have a chance to survive at the end (provided they still have a head attached)
Fixed missions sometimes being created for non-existent enemies
Fixed missions not spawning or vanishing
Fixed hair turning white on characters that were downed in a tactical battle
Fixed footprints on the world map not saving or loading correctly
Game now auto pauses on load, when leaving a settlement or when closing the crew menu (settings menu toggles for these will come in a later update)
Fixed some area of effect attacks not correctly displaying their targeted tiles
Fixed the difficulty display of some enemy packs on the world map not matching their actual difficulty
Fixed enemies using abilities when they did not have enough Focus
Fixed some higher tier weapons not having the correct damage
Fixed Shield item tooltip displaying unnecessary data
Mission reward money has been reworked, generally courier missions reward less
Fixed an issue that could make a courier missions secondary objective impossible
Fixed typos
Fixed game rolling a D101 rather than a D100
Fixed line of sight issues with outdoor battles with elevations

tags.balance_change: Force Field and Armour Penetration now scales with the targets remaining Force Field or Armour
Durability of equipment has changed, lower quality items now have less and higher quality items now have more

tags.feature: AI is now more aggressive when they or their team mates are targeted
AI should now know the requirements to use certain abilities

notes.title: 🚀 Space Scum Playtest Day 17 Update
notes.content: [h1]🛰️ [b]Mercenaries, Report In![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone taking part in the Space Scum Playtest and sharing your thoughts. Your reports keep helping us squash bugs and refine the game’s systems.[/p][p]Version [b]0.6.5.8[/b] is now live, it adds three new skills to master, smarter AI, balance tweaks, and plenty of bug fixes. Jump back in and see how the galaxy feels after this update![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes & Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash with an unknown weapon ID[/p][/*][*][p]Made sure status effects are always removed after a battle[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crew above level 3 not being checked for the main quest requiring the player to be level 3 or higher[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some elevation issues with AOE abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters on the map not changing their speed immediately after changing the game speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos and text alignment errors[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]New Skills & Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Side Step[/b] lets the user move freely this turn without triggering attacks of opportunity[/p][/*][*][p][b]Belt Trick[/b] allows a character to switch items from their pack once per turn for free[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dead Man’s Luck[/b] prevents the character from being critically hit[/p][/*][/list][h3]🤖 [b]Units & Drones[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Drones and Robot Drones have been combined and can now be equipped by either species[/p][/*][*][p]Robots no longer show morale indicators[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚔️ [b]Factions & NPC Variety[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Galactic Ascendants patrolling cities now spawn in greater numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Galactic Ascendants can now spawn away from cities[/p][/*][*][p]Galactic Ascendants, Scavengers, Mercenaries, and Yolihuani Empire now have additional backgrounds and equip additional types of armour and weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Many of these non-player backgrounds will not appear in game until day 3 to 5[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Weapon Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Sniper Rifle AP cost changed from 6 to 7[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper Reload cost changed from 6 to 8[/p][/*][*][p]Shotgun range changed from 6 to 7[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]AI reacts better when targeted[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📡 [b]That's All For Now[/b][/h2][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep on survivin’![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p]Another Forklift-published game [b]Roman Triumph[/b] has just launched in 1.0! 🏛️[/p][p]Build your city, defend it from invaders, please the gods, and see how long you can survive 👇🏻[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864880/Roman_Triumph_Survival_City_Builder/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3751340/view/500584344614601417"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Space Scum Playtest Day 13 Update
notes.content:
[h1]🛰️ Attention Mercenaries! [/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone jumping into the Space Scum Playtest and sharing your feedback. Your reports are helping us squash bugs fast and smooth out the experience.[/p][p]We’ve just deployed [b]Version 0.6.5.3[/b], focusing on crash fixes, gameplay stability, and smarter AI behavior. Jump back in and let us know how it feels!
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes and Stability[/b][/h3][p]• Fixed crash when playing over 50 turns in a tactical battle[/p][p]• Fixed crash whilst dragging an inventory item and right clicking[/p][p]• Fixed crash when a player character is on the edge of the tactical battle map and the AI takes the next turn[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][p]• Fixed weapons in a character’s pack permanently increasing Focus when saving and loading[/p][p]• Fixed some tile costs in the tactical battle[/p][p]• Fixed manual saves being unexpectedly overwritten[/p][p]• Fixed health sometimes showing as 0 when it was actually slightly above 0[/p][p]• Fixed issues with accuracy display showing “Out of Range” or “Too Far”[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][p]• Improved the AI to not be as likely to “conga line”[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]📡 That's All For Now[/h3][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, don’t forget to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p]Until next time, keep on survivin’![/p][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3751340/view/500584344614601021"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: • Fixed crash when playing over 50 turns in a tactical battle
• Fixed crash whilst dragging an inventory item and right clicking
• Fixed crash when a player character is on the edge of the tactical battle map and the AI takes the next turn
• Fixed weapons in a character’s pack permanently increasing Focus when saving and loading
• Fixed some tile costs in the tactical battle
• Fixed manual saves being unexpectedly overwritten
• Fixed health sometimes showing as 0 when it was actually slightly above 0
• Fixed issues with accuracy display showing “Out of Range” or “Too Far”
• Improved the AI to not be as likely to “conga line”

Fixed decimal number errors on crew stat screen
Fixed various typos
Fixed Reload ability cost of Shotguns
Removed option to choose ultra wide resolution when the player did not have an ultra wide monitor

notes.title: Space Scum Playtest Day 3 Update
notes.content:
[h1]🛰️ Attention Mercenaries! [/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who’s been diving into the Space Scum Playtest and sharing your feedback! It’s been a huge help in tracking down issues quickly and improving the balance so you can keep having fun out there.[/p][p]We’ve just pushed another patch live, tackling several crashes, fixing shop problems, and smoothing out some gameplay rough edges. Jump back in and let us know how it feels!
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed being unable to sell any amount of a stacked item if the shop did not have enough money to buy the entire stack[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of money shops have[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shops sometimes showing the individual price of an item in a stack as the price of the entire stack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies shooting at the player at night even when they could not see them[/p][/*][*][p]Inventories are now fully reset between playthroughs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when having a crew member on the ship and loading the game via the pause menu (should resolve multiple reports of unusable crew members)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when moving equipment around on a crew member[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items sometimes being duplicated when moving equipment around on a crew member[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items sometimes vanishing when moving equipment around on a crew member[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash with rocket and psi projectiles[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]📡 That's All For Now[/h3][p][/p][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, don’t forget to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep on survivin’![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Space Scum Playtest Day 1&2 Updates
notes.content:
[h1]🛰️ Attention Mercenaries! [/h1][p][/p][p]We know it's only been a couple of days since we launched the Open Playtest, but the response so far has beeen amazing! A huge thanks to everyone that's played and given us their feedback already, we've been working hard to address your thoughts and suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p]We released our first patch yesterday and have just released our second big patch today, full of tweaks, changes and improvements to make the game even better while you play. So feel free to jump back in and check out the new version! And for those wanting a breakdown of what we've done so far, read on...
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]⚙️ Day 1 Patch Notes:[/h2][list][*][p]More repair tools in Marketplaces;[/p][/*][*][p]Repair tools can now also appear in weapon and armour shops;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game sometimes becoming permanently paused after abandoning a mission;[/p][/*][*][p]Abandoning a mission now removes the marker from that missions target;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an inventory crash when swapping a two handed weapon for another two handed weapon that was in the characters pack;[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus ranged defence gained from 'moving target' has been reduced on enemies to improve accuracy;[/p][/*][*][p]Friendly sentries that are destroyed no longer cause morale drops to the players characters;[/p][/*][*][p]Rifle single shot damage has been increased;[/p][/*][*][p]A missions bonus objective now reward much more money;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect difficulty display on mission targets;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed melee weapons sometimes using ranged skill resulting in unexpectedly poor accuracy.[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes have been in since yesterday and hopefully you'll have noticed the differences today.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔧 Day 2 Patch Notes:[/h2][list][*][p]Tweaked Weapons accuracies;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed world map errors when playing at 4K resolution;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash rebinding keys;[/p][/*][*][p]Missions now reward more money;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced wages of crew;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced recruitment cost of crew;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed a quest reward from medkit to force field;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the 2nd battle quest against mercenaries to be against scavengers;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the damage of rusted weapons;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount received from selling items from 15% or their value to 20%;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed melee weapons being unable to attack if you switched to them from a sniper rifle;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resistance skills not applying the intended resists;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed showing a large negative accuracy value when attempting to move over fog of war;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quest rewards sometimes showing as damaged;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to deploy inside walls;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed new crew members having the wrong colour plinth base;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed offhand equipment vanishing when moving a two handed weapon between two pack slots;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when dragging an equipped item onto food in the inventory;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when swapping a two handed weapon for another two handed weapon that was in the characters pack;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the threshold for injuries to occur;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the severity of minor injuries;[/p][/*][*][p]HP healing times are now faster;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage, range and the forcefield strength of mindcarvers[/p][/*][*][p]Repair times are now faster.[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes have just gone live, so if you've been looking for some of these then look no further![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]📡 That's All For Now[/h3][p]We'll be doing one more update ahead of the weekend tomorrow, so if you have thoughts you want to share, any improvements you want to see or any bugs you'd like squished, please let us know in our [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (which can also be found in-game on the Main Menu!).[/p][p][/p][p]And of course if you want to keep up to date on Space Scum as it develops, chat with our community and talk to the Devs directly, [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]jump into our Discord[/url] too![/p][p][/p][p]Until then, keep on survivin'.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
